title: Coming up with an idea while playtesting
author: GTTGgames
selftext:
Anyone else discover a mechanic or game idea while simply just messing around in your game? I literally had the idea of making a skate park and adding your own items to skate on etc - because I had accidentally put down a random fence in the office. 

Full dev diary here: [https://youtu.be/n\_FrGfG520g?si=XQNNoQ6syCRrf-0T](https://youtu.be/n_FrGfG520g?si=XQNNoQ6syCRrf-0T)

comments.author: That1guy4226
comments.body: I made something similar ish. I made an office skyscraper filled with decks like that. There is a monkey at every desk bashing on the keys. You could stop and inspect any screen. Sometimes you'd words. Was neat. This is really cool.

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: haha. yeah I love the idea of seeing what is on the screens. In my game you can write at your computer in your apartment and it saves it, even small things like that make me smile. but yeah..im totally making a skate park after this random moment (I had fence in my inventory I forgot about!)
